product_metadata.title: NuWave stainless steel pressure cooker, 6.5 Quart, Silver
features: Quick And Healthy Meals- The Pressure Cooker Needs Little Oil And Can Cook Healthy Meals In Minutes Without Hassel.
Versatile- The Nuwave Pressure Cooker Can Be Used On Induction Cooktop, Gas Stoves Or Electric Burners.
Quality- Use Of The Premium Grade Stainless Steel Makes This Hardy And Long-Lasting Product.
description: Made from the highest quality premium grade stainless steel, the 6.5-Quart NuWave pressure cooker allows you to prepare everything from soups to rice to full, flavorful meals in a fraction of the time. It was designed with three safety features to give you Peace of mind while you cook your entire meal in just one pot. By combining the fast heating of the PIC with the speed you only get from pressure-cooking, dinner will be ready up to 3 times faster than conventional cooking methods with the induction-ready, easy-to-clean pressure cooker

details.Special Feature: Gas Stovetop Compatible, Electric Stovetop Compatible, Induction Stovetop Compatible
